resources.string: Draw from the current queue and avoid playing the same song twice in a row.
Prefer songs you have not played recently and separate songs by the same artist or from the same album.
Use a longer listening history when drawing from the current queue.
Draw from all songs indexed on this phone, including songs outside the current queue. Avoid the last 25 songs when possible.
One pass per queue, pure random, and album shuffle.
The next song stays selected until playback advances. When the source is small, songs played least recently become eligible again.
